title: Letter to Lyman Wight and Others, 16 August 1834
source_note: JS, Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to Lyman Wight, Edward Partridge, John Corrill, Isaac Morley, and others, [Liberty, Clay Co.], MO, 16 Aug. 1834. Retained copy, [ca. 16 Aug. 1834], in JS Letterbook 1, pp. 84–87; handwriting of Frederick G. Williams; CHL. Includes redactions. For more complete source information, see the source note for JS Letterbook 1.
